name: Calibration reference selection
question: Which stars should be observed as calibration references for the context's anchor targets?

features.name: calibration_suitability
features.rationale: Only an endorsed calibration-reference relationship to an anchor target, scaled by assessed stability, makes a star a calibrator here.

features.name: proximity_to_anchor
features.rationale: A reference close on the sky shares airmass and extinction with the anchor. Declared use of proximity.

features.name: evidence_quality
features.rationale: A well-characterised reference is worth more.
